Recorded claim:
Put serializable session/draft state, baseline, dirty sections, and validation in Redux. Keep raw `calIEvent`, `calIDateTime`, `calIAttendee`, DOM/editor instances, and live calendar references out. Bug `2061213` is the first create/edit draft/Redux landing; `2061214`/`2061218` own transactions. Start save/edit/delete as direct async controllers around platform objects; consider shared mutation thunks only after a proven shared serializable transaction contract. [Task 4]
